dedupe_keys.name: cms archive hcahps and hospital rating joiner

description: This Python project prepares annual hospital quality tables from the CMS Hospital Compare archive. Its scripts select the most recent revised flat-file package for each archive year, read Hospital General Information and HCAHPS hospital files, align column names and types, and left-join the two series on facility ID and year. The documented output is one CSV per release year; 2014 and 2015 are excluded because their general-information files lack overall star ratings. The README warns that facility IDs must remain strings so leading zeroes survive. A modeller could use the joined hospital attributes to define facility classes or compare service-quality indicators in a healthcare-capacity study. The project publishes its Python scripts and instructions, but no prepared annual output files. The official CMS archive page returned only a JavaScript shell to this review, so the current ZIP selectors, data schema and successful execution were not verified. The MIT repository licence covers code; source-data terms remain those of CMS. Coverage is United States Medicare-certified hospitals in the archive years available to the script, subject to the exclusions and current CMS availability. For simulation, the joined attributes may inform hospital-service scenarios, but the script does not simulate patient flows. Related upstream resources are the two CMS source tables and their release documentation, whose current fields were not inspected here.
licence: MIT for repository code; the upstream CMS data terms are separate.
